newsitem.title: USA: PriceCostco redeems $285.1 mln of debt.
newsitem.headline: PriceCostco redeems $285.1 mln of debt.

text.p: PriceCostco Inc said on Thursday it had redeemed $125.7 million of its 6-3/4 percent subordinated convertible debentures due 2001, and another $159.4 million of the debentures had been converted into common stock.
The company had offered to redeem the debentures at $1,036.74 per $1,000 of principal, which included accrued interest.
The debentures were eligible to be converted into stock at $22.535 a share, the company said.
PriceCostco, which issued 7.1 million shares in the conversion, closed at 23-1/4 on Wednesday.
The redemption portion of the transaction was financed with short-term bank borrowings, the company said.
